name: FreshBooks
summary: Invoicing and accounting software for service businesses, with estimates and proposals included.
differentiator: Estimates and proposals are unlimited on every plan, but the plans cap billable clients: 5 on Lite and 50 on Plus. That is the number to check if you quote many one-off homeowners. Team members cost $11 a month each on every plan, and the promotional rates (Lite at $1 a month for the first year) are not the regular price of $23.
pricing: Lite $23, Plus $43 and Premium $70 per month at regular price, with a Select tier on custom pricing. Current offers: Lite at $1 per month for a year, Plus and Premium at 80 percent off for three months. Billable clients: 5 on Lite, 50 on Plus, unlimited on Premium and Select. Team members $11 per month each. 30-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
category: Quoting and invoicing for small contractors
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan plus per team member
entryPrice: $23 per month regular ($1 per month first-year offer)
bestFor: Solo contractors and small crews who mainly need invoicing and accounting, with estimates attached.
skipIf: You need job scheduling or any bid management; it is accounting first.
